base64.b64decode called without validate=True — strings with only non-alphabet chars decode to b'' and surface as 400 'Empty file' rather than 400 'Invalid base64 content'. Behavior still correct (400), just a less precise message. Cosmetic.

rca_of_issue: ORIGINAL BUG: Expo winter expo/fetch runtime on native cannot convert React Native FormData — convertFormDataAsync throws 'Unsupported FormData implementation', crashing every photo/voice upload on real devices (Expo Go). FIX VERIFIED: native clients now send base64 JSON to /api/upload/base64, /api/vision/weight/path, /api/voice/transcribe/base64 (all backend endpoints tested 13/13); web keeps multipart (regression-tested E2E green). Grep confirms zero FormData usage on native paths. Remaining risk: native runtime untestable in this environment — needs one real-device smoke test.
